opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship is fully funded and will include all travel and subsistence, for the duration of the tour. ... The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1000, to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24, resident in the UK, with a demonstrable interest in the relevant industry (e.g. dairy, regenerative agriculture, pig).
opportunities.summary: A scholarship aimed at young people aged 18-24 to develop young talent in the farming industry. It provides a 30-day study tour (June/July) staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars, an induction day in London, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. Fully funded including all travel and subsistence, plus a £1000 financial incentive to part-cover replacement labour cost. Applications open in November 2026 and close on 25 February 2027.
